actual: A fresh qe_hmm_full_v2 monthly candidate submission dss_9c5977c4a22a98bd7039374401cd0cee terminates in source-freeze with SOURCE_STAGE_UNHANDLED_ERROR exception_type=DuplicateCursor. PostgresSourceSnapshotSession.stream names every server-side cursor only by query_id, while _iter_execution_rows opens multiple date/code chunk streams for the same query_id concurrently on one repeatable-read connection. The second stream collides with the first cursor name, so resolution stops before run creation. Safety receipt confirms candidate_writes=0, database_writes=0, production_writes=0 and service_process_controls=0. Fix must give each bounded stream a unique server-side cursor identity while preserving one snapshot, read-only semantics, fetch bounds, deterministic row merge, and fail-closed behavior.
